criterion: 確認與授權可追溯相同文件集合及版本；相關設計被改動時不得沿用舊確認，無關檔變更不阻擋；討論追加或相同內容重生成不產生重複授權要求。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Original task/event receipts remain valid across proven format migration and verified discussion-only extensions. Changed parts/design collections invalidate execution; historical reads do not authorize current apply/mkdir/move/delete. Unrelated files do not change the bound collection.
